eps.t: My First Time in a While
eps.o: J.D. enlists Turk and Elliot to help with Dr. Cox's care; Elliot finds an unexpected burst of confidence years in the making.
J.D. attempts an insurance workaround, creating tension with his new mentee; Elliot tries to guide Tosh's specialty choices; Turk flexes his own skills as a mentor.
J.D. reintroduces an old flame into Elliot’s life, as his new relationship continues to blossom. Meanwhile, Turk tries a new approach to keeping the spark alive at home.
After uncovering a costly mistake made by Turk, J.D. must decide whether to report him or let it slide. Meanwhile, Elliot grows her responsibilities at Sacred Heart by leading a new initiative.
